sources.scope: Same original compact-smooth gradient D precedes epsilon/f; derive ONE actual variational/localized resolvent u and actual weighted radial cutoff/commutator limits. assumptions: Finite real Hilbert/Borel E including0; V C2, NNReal alpha/beta with 0<alpha<=beta and actual all-point/all-vector alpha I<=HessV<=beta I. eta>0 and beta*eta<=1 are retained.

Actual Gaussian augmentation J=(x,x+sqrteta*xi)#(mu*standardGaussian) and common genuine Markov/disintegrating R/S with S_y=(2x-y)#R_y and S_y=volume.tilted(-W_y), W_y(z)=V((y+z)/2)+norm(z-y)^2/(8eta). Source C2 W_y, integrability/positive partition and original dense closable exact compact-smooth D_y with closed closure are produced. Only explicit W_y Hessian facts are extracted from the accepted curvature parent; its auxiliary R2/S2 are not equated with the resolvent kernels.

steps.title: Keep the genuine reflected kernels and original graph
steps.text: Consume the actual ConditionalLocalizedResolvent kernels/partition/original D_y before epsilon/f. Retain every original local/weak/cutoff fact. The shared global producer constructs the actual solution on this same graph, not an arbitrary supplied u or a new domain.

steps.title: Extract BOTH reflected Hessian bounds for the explicit potential
steps.text: Use the accepted conditional Hessian formula and source V bounds to derive m=(alpha+eta^-1)/4 and M=(beta+eta^-1)/4 with 0<m<=M. Only explicit W_y derivative facts are reused; auxiliary kernels are not identified. Reflected and unreflected RGO constants and laws remain distinct.

steps.title: Consume the actual shared global producer on original D_y
steps.text: Supply genuine S_y law equality, C2/partition/curvature and original closable exact graph. The shared producer derives ONE actual variational u, global quarter-scale coercivity and the forcing bound, with all original weak/local/cutoff data. No weighted cutoff limit or final inequality is an input.

steps.title: Exercise true nonquadratic curvature and exact5/8
steps.text: The focused Test proves V=3x^2/8+sin(x)/8 has curvature[1/2,1], chooses actual eta1/2 and source common J/R/S/originalD/u. It extracts the actual global constant5/8, residual forcing bound and original ordinary C2-cutoff data for rho(x)*abs(x)^5, without requiring that cutoff to be C-infinity.

steps.text: Actual kernel=constants, constant-domain membership, centered scaled residual/epsilon-zero/range/Poincare, linear-observable/BL, adjoint/core/global Bochner identity and both main/composition remain separate unproved obligations.
